items.title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 captures the franchise's bloody absurdity like nothing else
items.summary: Warhammer 40,000 is a universe of two distinct moods. On the one hand, it's a grimdark future of serious, solemn stories where trillions die in galactic wars of attrition; of tragedies and insurmountable threats. But there's also the other side of Warhammer 40,000, where goofy hilarity and gory absurdity lies.
